requested_visible_change: Use one fast contact panel on the ordinary corporate and New Year routes and place a contextual contact action on every price card.
expected_visible_delta: Each package card opens the shared panel with its package, date, displayed price and extension rate; the detailed six-field form is absent.

observations.result: The ordinary corporate package opened the corporate contact panel with its displayed price and short callback form.
A dated package showed the selected date, package price and extension rate in the same panel; local HTTP 201 and error states behaved correctly.
The bottom sheet, selection summary and short form stayed within the viewport without horizontal overflow.
